issues.description: Equal-rank terminal states overwrite based on ingest order, so an older terminal snapshot can replace newer final state, duration, and exit code.
Unknown Slurm states are treated as terminal, which can block later valid lifecycle updates for unlisted non-terminal states.
Report filtering and newest-record selection compare timestamps as text, producing wrong results for offset-aware or mixed-format ISO timestamps.
Offset-aware timestamps are accepted but not normalized to a canonical timezone before storage and reporting.
Negative AllocCPUS and GPU counts are accepted, allowing negative CPU-hour and GPU-hour totals.
Rows with empty user or partition values, or no usable submit/start/end reference time, are accepted and can create blank groups or invisible jobs.
Report queries scan computed COALESCE reference times without an indexed stored reference column, which will not scale well on large accounting histories.
Package version is duplicated separately from pyproject.toml and can drift during releases.
Development tooling only defines pytest, with no linting or typing checks to catch validation and API-contract regressions.
